name: Poutine
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 5, line cook 5

Flavor Profiles salty, temperature, umami, temperature, texture
Additional Ingredients umami

EFFECT

Duration 10 minutes, or 1 round/level when consumed; Serving Size 1d4
Saving Throw Fortitude negates

DESCRIPTION

Poutine is a large portion of fries covered in gravy and cheese curds.

When consumed, it creates a non-magical hold monster effect, as the spell, that requires a Fortitude save instead of Will and can affect mindless creatures for 1 round/level. A creature can only consume up to one serving of poutine per day.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each.
